title: 1 Samuel 31
paragraphs: ¹ The Philistines attacked Israel, and the Israelites fled before them. Many fell dead on Mount Gilboa. ² The Philistines pressed hard after Saul and his sons, and they killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, Saul's sons. ³ The fighting closed in around Saul, and archers found him and wounded him severely. ⁴ Saul said to his armor-bearer, "Draw your sword and run me through — otherwise these uncircumcised men will come and torture me." But his armor-bearer was terrified and would not do it. So Saul took his own sword and fell on it. ⁵ When the armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he too fell on his sword and died alongside him.

⁶ So Saul died that day, along with his three sons, his armor-bearer, and all his men. ⁷ When the Israelites on the other side of the valley and across the Jordan saw that the army had fled and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their towns and fled. The Philistines came and occupied them. ⁸ The next day, when the Philistines came to strip the dead, they found Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa. ⁹ They cut off his head and stripped off his armor, then sent messengers throughout Philistine territory to spread the news in the temples of their idols and among the people. ¹⁰ They put his armor in the temple of the Ashtoreths and fastened his body to the wall of Beth Shan.

¹¹ When the people of Jabesh Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul, ¹² all their fighting men set out through the night. They took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth Shan and brought them to Jabesh, where they burned them. ¹³ Then they took their bones and buried them under the tamarisk tree at Jabesh and fasted for seven days.
